industry: Cold storage services / mobile refrigeration and emergency freezer trailer hire

facts.source_snippet: North West specialists in emergency and event fridge and freezer trailer hire since 1997.

facts.claim: Headquarters are located in Warrington, United Kingdom.
facts.source_snippet: Based in Warrington, we serve the full North West — Manchester, Liverpool, Cheshire, and Lancashire — with rapid-response mobile refrigeration.

facts.claim: Provides emergency and event fridge and freezer trailer hire with rapid on‑site response (within 4 hours).
facts.source_snippet: On-site within 4 hours. Trusted by McDonald's, KFC, Subway, and leading names across hospitality, healthcare, and the licensed trade.

facts.claim: Serves a range of sectors including hospitality, healthcare, commercial kitchens, supermarkets, and breweries across the North West of England.
facts.source_snippet: We work with hotels, restaurants, catering companies, and event venues needing reliable cold storage at short notice. Our emergency breakdown service supports supermarkets, food retailers, and commercial kitchens when installed refrigeration fails. We're a trusted supplier to NHS trusts and hospital facilities teams across the region.
